findings.title: http:// does not redirect to https://
findings.detail: http://example.com/ answered 200 instead of redirecting to HTTPS.
findings.fix: Add a permanent (301/308) redirect from http:// to https:// at the host or CDN.

findings.title: No Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.detail: Without HSTS a first visit over http:// can be intercepted before the redirect.
findings.fix: Send `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains` on HTTPS responses.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy
findings.detail: A CSP limits what an injected script can load or send, and is the main defence-in-depth against XSS.
findings.fix: Start with `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'` plus the API/CDN origins the app needs, test with Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first.

findings.title: Page can be framed by any site (clickjacking)
findings.detail: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set.
findings.fix: Send `X-Frame-Options: DENY` (or SAMEORIGIN) or add `frame-ancestors 'self'` to the CSP.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is missing
findings.detail: Browsers may MIME-sniff uploads or API responses into executable content.

findings.title: No Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Full URLs (including tokens in query strings) can leak to third-party sites via the Referer header.

findings.title: No Permissions-Policy
findings.detail: Embedded third-party code can request camera, microphone or geolocation.
findings.fix: Send e.g. `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()` and allow only what the app uses.

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.detail: https://example.com/robots.txt returned an HTML page (app fallback).
findings.fix: Add a robots.txt that allows crawling and points to the sitemap (`Sitemap: https://…/sitemap.xml`).

findings.title: No sitemap found
findings.fix: Generate a sitemap.xml (next-sitemap, @nuxtjs/sitemap, vite-plugin-sitemap) and list it in robots.txt.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.detail: Search engines will pick a random text snippet.
